Catalog and local editing
Catalog references. Gallery items describe named design choices. Open an item in the editor to use it in a deck.
Local slide editing. The visual OPF editor supports OPF import, content and property edits, live preview, undo/redo, and editable PowerPoint export in your browser. Save OPF to keep your changes; review exported slides in PowerPoint with the chosen fonts installed.
Free access. No ads, no accounts, no paywalls. PPTX.gallery is a free public good. Revenue in the ecosystem lives in PPTX.dev’s paid API.
